source: User-supplied 156-idea compilation, item 3.6: read F positions, gaps or presence as an independent numeric/binary stream. This test is a new narrowly specified direct-gap variant, not a historical source replay.
question: Can every gap between consecutive F runes be read directly as one Gematria Primus symbol without skipping, wrapping or reducing values?
scope: LP2-00 through LP2-55; retain exactly the 29 GP runes in manuscript order, including headings; ignore punctuation and spacing.
strict_rule: Preserve every consecutive F pair under each boundary rule. Position distance is right ordinal minus left ordinal; intervening count is that distance minus one. A value maps only if it is literally in the chosen 29-value alphabet. Retain every unmapped gap as a gap, not a skipped symbol; a complete direct reading needs zero unmapped gaps.
controls: Synthetic gap sequence with GP prime distances 2, 3, 5, 7 and 11 must map under the exact-prime rule; synthetic distances 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 must map as zero-based indices. An out-of-range gap must remain unmapped.
excluded: No modulo 29, prime ordinal inversion, pad values, chosen subsets/fragments, byte packing, F-presence bits, absolute F positions, post-hoc page selection, key or plaintext reading.
